summary: Instruct policy in prompt template to rigorously test and verify custom scripts and parser outputs against requirements before completion.

edits.hypothesis: Adding explicit instructions to test and verify custom parsing scripts and their output schema helps prevent schema/specification mismatches in tasks like extracting structured binary or text data.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions guide the policy's planning process when authoring custom scripts in unfamiliar tasks.

retroactive_check.corrective: Would remind the policy to verify output against specification during binary/data extraction tasks like extract-elf.
retroactive_check.preservative: Does not restrict normal command execution or standard workflows.
retroactive_check.transfer: Applies generally to any task requiring custom scripts or parsers to match a strict output schema.

edits.mechanism: Adding explicit instructions to test and verify custom parsing scripts and their output schema helps prevent schema/specification mismatches in tasks like extracting structured binary or text data.
